research_failure.condition: Choose interventions for a specific learner challenge in a contextualized classroom exchange; fluent generic academic tutoring can miss the actual behavioral need.
research_failure.finding: The strongest of11 evaluated models satisfies at least one personalized rubric criterion in55.8% of open-ended cases; selection is stronger than situated response generation.
research_failure.model_setting: As released in the original source; this is a GLM source-task subset, not a reproduction of published model population.
research_failure.scope: Only the specified task condition; no generalized failure prevalence or learning-gain claim.

original_task.input_contract: Original minimal context/dialogue and immediate next-turn instruction, plus paired original MCQ
original_task.output_contract: Native short tutor response or MCQ JSON
original_task.scoring_contract: Open-ended original checklist ANY rule, Gemini3.1Pro; MCQ original answer key
original_task.environment_contract: Text response and native judge dependency for open-ended view

decision.rationale: Use released original tasks and controls; preserve original metric boundaries.
limitations: Original released dialogues/rubrics/MCQs are LLM-synthesized from literature; not raw human classroom transcripts.
Open-ended and MCQ views are paired, not independent samples, and must not be averaged together.
